limitations: Only these four assigned manual cases and four exact reference pairs were reviewed. This report does not declare the module or full round accepted or clean.
Saved action/state reads support only the captured static state. They are not new execution, input testing, preference persistence, download, localization or hardware verification.

The reference display was reduced by the image-viewing tool for presentation; its declared original dimensions remain 1860 x 2480. Essential labels, borders, rules and markers were readable within the eight-open budget.

No numeric pixel metric, font-file identity, contrast-ratio measurement, hidden hit-region check, physical input, framebuffer/evdev rotation, sleep/wake, e-ink effect or performance result is claimed.
